messages:
alex.r: Quick reminder — CareWell POC wraps tomorrow. Need to: revoke hosted key, deprovision dedicated pool cw-pool-3, flush KV cache, and confirm S3 log retention policy.
nina.ops: I can handle infra. Please confirm key id + S3 bucket name.
alex.r: Key is hk-CW9X, pool cw-pool-3, bucket s3://carewell-poc-logs. Contact: mike@carewell (mike-cw). Also they requested a short-term 14-day audit hold instead of standard 90d — legal asked for formal approval.
harper.sec: 14d is acceptable for non-PHI POCs. If any PHI, must keep default. Can the customer confirm no PHI in logs?
alex.r: Customer confirmed no PHI in logs via email. I'll pin the email to the ticket.
nina.ops: Plan: 1) cordon pool 2) run kv-flush -> `./scripts/kv_flush.sh cw-pool-3` 3) snapshot weights -> automation job snap-cw-177999 4) revoke key then delete pool. I'll schedule at 02:00 UTC.
telegraf-bot: Automation: snap-cw-177999 initiated; upload target gs://redwood-snaps/carewell/177999.
harper.sec: Please ensure key rotation logs are retained and a signed entry in the audit log. Use `POST /internal/audit/events` with payload `{"action": "key_revoke", "actor": "nina.ops", "target": "hk-CW9X"}` for the record.
nina.ops: Got it — will append audit entry and attach snapshot checksum. Snapshot checksum sha256: a3b4c5d6e7f8g9h0.
alex.r: Legal approved 14-day hold; please set S3 lifecycle to 14d and create readonly audit DB user with 14-day TTL.
harper.sec: Creating readonly DB user now and setting creds in customer's vault. Will expire in 14 days.
telegraf-bot: Pool cw-pool-3 cordoned at 1780001200; KV flush completed at 1780001800.
nina.ops: Revoking hosted key hk-CW9X: `curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/admin/keys/hk-CW9X/revoke -d '{"reason":"poc_end","ticket":"REDW-6120"}'` -> 200 OK.
telegraf-bot: Pool cw-pool-3 drained and deleted at 1780003000. All allocations evicted.
nina.ops: S3 lifecycle set to 14 days for s3://carewell-poc-logs. Purge scheduled for 1781210000.
harper.sec: Audit entries written and screenshot attached to REDW-6120. Readonly DB user created: carewell_audit (expires in 14d).
alex.r: I'll send handoff + final confirmation to the customer and legal, attach snapshots to the ticket, and close when purge window starts. Thanks everyone :raised_hands: 
telegraf-bot: Ticket REDW-6120 updated: snapshots attached, lifecycle set.
alex.r: Closing loop — customer acknowledged and confirmed pickup. Thread closed :white_check_mark:
